import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
import stability
candidate=json.loads((root/'artifacts/shutdown-state-candidate.json').read_text())
binary=root/candidate['directory']/'war-relay'
client=root/'artifacts/baselines/address-churn-client/stress'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
record={'scope':'Four sequential fresh four-worker servers with per-IP concurrent limit64 enabled.32 clients on loopback; traffic4s,churn4s,slow4s,fanout4s; churn rotates4,096 source addresses. Server CPUs0-3/client CPUs4-7. Existing complete payload/FIFO/Close/counter/resource checks, no admission denials expected under the configured cap. Fanout has27 healthy readers/four unread,one-ms reader delay,cyclic256B/1KiB/64KiB/256KiB values,window16. Functional acceptance, not a before/after timing comparison.',
    'server_sha256':sha(binary),'stress_sha256':sha(client),'cases':[],'driver_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
for mode,seconds in [('traffic',4),('churn',4),('slow',4),('fanout',4)]:
    case=stability.run_case(mode,seconds,32,server_binary=binary,stress_binary=client,
        server_cpus='0-3',client_cpus='4-7',source_addresses=4096 if mode=='churn' else 0,server_args=['--max-connections-per-ip','64'],
        payload_sizes=[256,1024,65536,262144] if mode=='fanout' else None,
        unread_clients=4 if mode=='fanout' else 0,reader_delay_ms=1 if mode=='fanout' else 0)
    assert case['passed'] and case['final']['metrics']['war_ip_rejected_total']=='0'
    record['cases'].append(case)
    (root/'docs/benchmarks/2026-10-16-shutdown-state-stability.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
